message: 団結
Just as I thought, I haven't felt that presence from yesterday since then.
Maybe I'm just overthinking it...

name: Paqy
message: 「What's the matter, got an upset stomach or somethin'?」

name: Synn
message: 「No. It's just that I had a weird feeling yesterday...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wasn't it a Demon?」

name: Synn
message: 「It felt kind of different from usual...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What, do Demon Lords come equipped with a monster antenna or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, something like that, I guess」

name: Synn
message: 「Though yesterday's felt more like a bad premonition than anything」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, your hunches are never reliable anyway, Synn, so it's fine, it's fine」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope you're right」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, good morning, Misa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's the big rush, did something happen?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, it's terrible!」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Misa
message: 「Just come this way! Hurry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, hey, Misa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's all the commotion, is a festival starting or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't look like it's anything that fun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san... Did something happen?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though it might be more accurate to say that something seems to have happened」

name: Melilot
message: 「In any case, let's go inside」

name: Synn
message: 「Right...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please, be very careful...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is someone... there...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Over there...」

name: Bylous
message: 「That presence... Is it the Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you in a place like this...」

name: Misa
message: 「We had morning choir practice today, and I found him then, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's pretty damn worn out...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems he's been in this state since around last night...」

name: Synn
message: 「Last... night...」
Then that presence from back then was...!
Melilot-san and I silently exchange glances.
I knew it, so that really was him...

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous, what on earth happened...?」

name: Bylous
message: 「As you can see, I was merely caught off guard...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why would something like this...」

name: Bylous
message: 「To think the power of Re-Crea was that immense...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Guh, ugh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous, hang in there!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, don't approach him so carelessly...!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Can you stand?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Mgh... yeah...」

name: Melilot
message: 「What are you planning to do」

name: Synn
message: 「He's injured. I can't just leave him like this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about, Synn? Isn't this guy our enemy?」

name: Misa
message: 「She's right, it's dangerous!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Maybe so. But...」

name: Synn
message: 「That still doesn't make it okay to leave someone who's hurt behind」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... That rock-solid confidence and composure--truly worthy of the Demon Lord!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...It can't be helped, then」

name: Melilot
message: 「We will look after him here」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Melilot
message: 「Not at all. That is one of your best qualities, after all, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous. I trust you understand, but...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I have no interest in anything other than a fair, all-out fight...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...You ought to thank Sakura-kun」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmph... To think the day would come when I'd end up in your debt...」

name: Bylous
message: 「That is everything I can tell you」

name: Helena
message: 「I see... So that's what happened...」

name: Ria
message: 「To think Azel-san was the agent of Re-Crea...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No wonder she was always skipping school.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that unrelated...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「And Soltia was supporting her, then...」

name: Synn
message: 「So the two of them really were aiming to bring about Re-Crea...」

name: Helena
message: 「With all this information lined up, there's no doubt about it.」

name: Bylous
message: 「...To think a god actually existed.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I suppose the records weren't entirely lacking in credibility after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Still, it's strange...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel definitely said it was God's will, right?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Unless he was just spouting delirious nonsense out of sheer fanaticism.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then God is making Azel the agent to trigger Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「That would mean Melilot-san's hypothesis was right, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「That contradicts the whole idea that Re-Crea is a natural phenomenon.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If it's an intentional phenomenon caused by God, it certainly contradicts the existence of the tower.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, there are no flaws in either the records or the facts so far...」

name: Melilot
message: 「When it comes to God's intention in presenting both survival and rebirth at the same time...」

name: Helena
message: 「Maybe God is trying to let us choose between them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Choose...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Building the tower to prepare for Re-Crea, or triggering Re-Crea itself...」

name: Helena
message: 「Everything is left in the hands of those who live in this world, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「So what happens to us... is up to us, then.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That god sounds kinda irresponsible, huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's tyrannical! Please go easier on us!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it means that if we put in the effort, there's a future waiting for us that's worth it, right」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sure it means God is giving us a chance\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「While I do think that is a somewhat distasteful conjecture...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It also makes a strange amount of sense」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, what we need to do was decided long ago」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Melilot
message: 「To free Azel from the seat of the Agent, and save the world...」

name: Melilot
message: 「To drive back Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's what we must do right now...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's overcome Re-Crea together and seize our future!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...If that is the will of the gods, then dancing to their tune is certainly one option」

name: Helena
message: 「So, what do you intend to do?」

name: Bylous
message: 「...What do I intend to do, huh」

name: Bylous
message: 「If we defeat the Agent, we may even come face-to-face with the god reigning above them...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I can expect as much, correct?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let us just say that the possibility exists」

name: Bylous
message: 「That's enough」

name: Bylous
message: 「Besides, it seems the Demon Lord is trying to gain even more power as well」

name: Bylous
message: 「If a god shows itself, there's no telling if he won't gain even greater power in response」

name: Bylous
message: 「Then there's no way I can sit out of this fight」

name: Helena
message: 「So I can take that to mean you're willing to fight alongside us?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Only because the obstacle in our path happens to be the same.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, wait--does that mean...」

name: Melilot
message: 「How wonderful that you've found a new sparring partner, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-ahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「Please go easy on me...」

name: Helena
message: 「With that, there's nothing left to hesitate about.」

name: Helena
message: 「...I'm counting on you, Synn-chan. Melilot.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right.」
I wasn't sure if I should simply be happy to have such reassuring backup...
Still, with an unexpected ally added to our ranks.
United anew, we pressed forward toward Re-Crea.
